definitions.gloss: bonesetting clinic; osteopathic clinic; chiropractic-style clinic
definitions.explanation: A clinic run by a licensed judo therapist (柔道整復師) that treats bone fractures, dislocations, sprains, and muscle injuries through manual therapy. Very common in Japan and covered by health insurance for certain treatments.

examples.japanese: {腰|こし}が{痛|いた}いので{整骨院|せいこついん}に{行|い}ってきた。
examples.english: My lower back hurt, so I went to an osteopathic clinic.

examples.japanese: {駅前|えきまえ}に{新|あたら}しい{整骨院|せいこついん}がオープンした。
examples.english: A new bonesetting clinic opened in front of the station.

examples.japanese: スポーツで{怪我|けが}をしたら、{病院|びょういん}だけでなく{整骨院|せいこついん}に{通|かよ}う{人|ひと}も{多|おお}い。
examples.english: When people get injured playing sports, many go not only to the hospital but also to a bonesetting clinic.

notes:
USAGE:
{整骨院|せいこついん} is also called {接骨院|せっこついん}. Both refer to the same type of clinic. They are distinct from {整体院|せいたいいん} (bodywork/chiropractic clinic), which is not covered by health insurance.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {整骨院|せいこついん}に{通|かよ}う (to go regularly to a bonesetting clinic)
- {整骨院|せいこついん}で{治療|ちりょう}を{受|う}ける (to receive treatment at a bonesetting clinic)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {接骨院|せっこついん}: same meaning, alternative name
- {整体院|せいたいいん}: bodywork/chiropractic clinic — not insurance-covered, different qualifications
- {鍼灸院|しんきゅういん}: acupuncture and moxibustion clinic
